clips.title: The story
paras: Brock Stoneseeker is a dwarven mining instructor based in the settlement of Thelsamar in Loch Modan. As the proprietor of Brock's School of Mining and Surveying, he instructs novice prospectors in the craft of extracting valuable ores and minerals from the earth.

Operating out of Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker directs Brock's School of Mining and Surveying. In the mineral-rich hills of Loch Modan, seasoned expertise with a pickaxe and an eye for geological veins are indispensable. Brock guides aspiring miners through the foundational techniques of identifying ore nodes, extracting raw metals, and properly surveying subterranean deposits, ensuring Alliance tradesfolk can fuel Ironforge's legendary smithies.
